questions.q: Who were the sons of Israel?
questions.a: The sons of Israel were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

questions.q: What happened to Er, Judah’s firstborn son?
questions.a: He was wicked in the eyes of Yahweh, so Yahweh killed him.

questions.q: Who did Tamar bear to Judah?
questions.a: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore Perez and Zerah to him, making five sons of Judah in all.

questions.q: How did Achan bring trouble on Israel?
questions.a: He stole some things that Yahweh had told the Israelites to destroy completely.

questions.q: Who was Jesse’s ancestor, going back to Ram?
questions.a: Ram fathered Amminadab, Amminadab fathered Nahshon, Nahshon fathered Salmon, Salmon fathered Boaz, Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse.

questions.q: Who was the seventh son of Jesse?
questions.a: David was the seventh son of Jesse.

questions.q: Who were Zeruiah and Abigail, and who were Zeruiah’s sons?
questions.a: Zeruiah and Abigail were the sisters of Jesse’s sons, and Zeruiah’s sons were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

questions.q: Who did Caleb marry after Azubah died, and who was their son?
questions.a: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, and she bore him a son named Hur.

questions.q: Who was Segub’s son, and how many cities did he have?
questions.a: Segub’s son was Jair, and Jair had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

questions.q: What did Geshur and Aram take from Jair’s descendants?
questions.a: Geshur and Aram took Havvoth Jair, Kenath, and its surrounding towns, sixty cities in all.

questions.q: Who did Hezron’s wife Abijah bear after his death?
questions.a: After Hezron died, his wife Abijah bore him a son named Ashhur, who became the father of Tekoa.

questions.q: Since Sheshan had no sons, what did he do with his daughter?
questions.a: Sheshan had only daughters, so he gave one of his daughters to his Egyptian servant Jarha to be his wife, and she bore a son named Attai.

questions.q: Who was Caleb’s firstborn son, and who was his descendant?
questions.a: Caleb’s firstborn son was Mareshah, and Mareshah’s descendant was Hebron.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Hur, and what towns did they found?
questions.a: Hur’s sons were Shobal, who founded Kiriath Jearim; Salma, who founded Bethlehem; and Hareph, who founded Beth Gader.
Salma’s descendants included the people of Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahathites, and the Zorites.

questions.q: Who were the clans of scribes living in Jabez, and where did they come from?
questions.a: The clans of scribes living in Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites, and they were Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

commentary.text: —We are now come to the register of the children of Israel, that distinguished people, who were to dwell alone, and not be reckoned among the nations. But now, in Christ, all are welcome to his salvation who come to him; all have equal privileges according to their faith in him, their love and devotedness to him. All that is truly valuable consists in the favour, peace, and image of God, and a life spent to his glory, in promoting the welfare of our fellow-creatures.
